desc:
BAKING MIX: Baking mix that makes fluffy, mouthwatering pancakes, biscuits and more

QUICK AND EASY: Just add milk and an egg, pour onto griddle, and start crafting

INGREDIENTS: This all-purpose baking mix contains no artificial flavors and no artificial colors

ENDLESS OPTIONS: Personalize your breakfast favorites with fruits, nuts or chocolate chips

CONTAINS: 5.5 oz (Pack of 9)
features:
Key Features:

All‑Purpose Mix

A versatile flour-based blend ready for making biscuits, pancakes, waffles, dumplings, and more.

Just Add Liquid

Requires only water, milk, or eggs (depending on the recipe) — no measuring of flour and leavening needed.

Pre‑Blended Leavening

Contains baking soda, baking powder, and other rising agents for consistent, reliable results.

Rich Flavor Base

Made with enriched flour and a bit of fat to support classic taste and texture.

Large Package

Commonly sold in 5‑lb boxes—perfect for families or frequent baking.

 Benefits:

Time‑Saving & Easy

Eliminates precise measuring; just add the liquid and stir—it’s perfect when you want quick baked goods without much prep.

Versatility at Home

From biscuits to cobblers, pancakes to casseroles, it adapts to sweet or savory recipes—great for creative cooking.

Consistent Results

Packaged leavening means predictable rise and texture—fewer baking flops.

Cost‑Effective

Bulk size provides more baking per dollar than smaller, specialized mixes.

Comforting Homemade Flavor

Delivers warm, bakery-style results without the fuss of from-scratch baking.
ingredients: Enriched Flour (wheat flour, niacin, iron, thiamin mononitrate, riboflavin, folic acid), Palm Oil, Leavening (baking soda, sodium aluminum phosphate, monocalcium phosphate), Dextrose, Salt.
